phase: Phase 0: Freeze failure cases, contracts, and role boundaries

findings.title: Phase 0 validators accepted forged or incomplete success envelopes
findings.detail: The reviewed implementation accepted arbitrary success-like statuses, missing schema/kind/contract fields, forged baseline values, mismatched attempt reason codes, and manifests without live fixture-hash verification. sweep_phase0 also ignored dangling A12 guards when deriving its overall result.

findings.title: Positive control encoded an unsupported APK product claim
findings.detail: control_claim.json named Dragon Flight and asserted movement behavior with an all-zero cited-range hash. It was therefore unsafe as a positive control and contradicted the Phase 0 prohibition on APK product conclusions. The control now uses an explicitly synthetic, non-product fixture identity.

findings.title: Numeric resource contract accepted non-positive values and dates as units
findings.detail: Zero/negative ceilings and a numeric date key could pass as measured resources. The parser now requires a positive integer and a concrete alphabetic unit label.

findings.title: Plan claims did not identify post-Green security corrections
findings.detail: The Phase 0 plan attributed completion only to ad45eebd even though that revision was fail-open. The plan now records the security fixes, current test count, versioned review gate, and the unresolved A12 state without claiming repository-wide resolution.

findings.title: Required independent role provenance is absent
findings.detail: phase0.json explicitly contains NOT_FABRICATED placeholders rather than tool-resolved spawn/event IDs, response hashes, context hashes, timestamps, and commit binding. It also acknowledges that one Red author produced both contracts and counterexamples. This honesty is preferable to forgery, but the artifact cannot satisfy FR3 or the Phase 0 closeout gate. The plan correctly leaves the role-spawn task incomplete; Phase 0 must not be accepted until authentic distinct-role receipts are resolved through the real event adapter.

findings.title: Repository-wide A12 and marker gates remain red
findings.detail: Seven catalog guard references remain dangling, and tests/orchestrator_marker_vocabulary.sh reports deprecated blank markers in unrelated active tracks. The reviewed gate now fails closed on dangling guards, but Phase 4 and any global completion claim remain blocked until owners remediate or formally change those shared contracts.

anti_pattern_checks.A2: not triggered; reviewed changes contain no draft-to-published transition
anti_pattern_checks.A4: empty positive and negative corpora rejected
anti_pattern_checks.A5: plan claims corrected to include review fixes
anti_pattern_checks.A6: measure/tracks.md remains pending and does not claim this gate resolved
anti_pattern_checks.A8: focused validator passes; repository-wide marker command remains red
anti_pattern_checks.A10: no generated product facts used as evidence
anti_pattern_checks.A12: aggregate gate now fails closed; seven pre-existing dangling references remain
anti_pattern_checks.A13: not triggered; track is active and not archived

tests.result: PASS: existence/headings only; does not resolve A12 debt

disposition: Do not close Phase 0 or begin successor APK work. Authentic distinct-role/event provenance and the shared aggregate blockers remain unresolved.
